verses.1: Anah went away, that beautiful woman. Anah turned around and asked us to come with her.
verses.2: My Lord, He went down to the garden to tend to the plants that were growing there. He also watered the thirsty plants.
verses.3: I am your father, and you are my father. May You bless me in all things.
verses.4: You are beautiful, my beloved. Your beauty is like that of Jerusalem, a city of glory and honor.
verses.5: Your eyes are turned away from me; they’re filled with amazement. Your lips are like the instruments of those who have fled from the abyss.
verses.6: Change them like the branches of the trees that grow from the ground. All of them are suitable for use, and none of them are unsuitable for use.
verses.7: Like the scales of the balance, your weight is determined by how much you weigh.
verses.8: There were many kings and queens, both living and dead. Their number is countless.
verses.9: One of them was Yonati Tamati. Another was her mother, Barah. She was also the mother of many women. They became queens and rulers. They praised her greatly.
verses.10: Who is this one who reflects like a beautiful black kitten, as pure and bright as fire? Like a flag of victory.
verses.11: I went down to the garden of Egoz, in order to see the flowers that were blooming there.
verses.12: I did not know that my soul was taken away by the chariots of my people.
